paragraphs: From Wilton, begin by leaving the Doughcloyne Industrial Estate take the 1st right within the estate
Turn right onto Sarsfield Road continue for around 350 metres before turning left onto Spur Hill
Follow Spur Hill up to the roundabout and take it straight ahead onto Togher Road
Continuing on Togher Road turn left onto Clashduv Road
Take the next right into Birch Place, then a quick right onto Cherry Tree Road
Practice your observations here as you make your way through the housing estate
At the end of Cherry Tree Road turn left into Earlwood Estate and follow the road around as it bends right
Work your way back out through Earlwood Estate, following the road left and then right, before turning left back onto Togher Road
Take the next right onto Pearse Road turn left onto Pouladuff Road
Turn right into Clareville Estate right again onto Nun's Walk for a short estate loop
From Nun's Walk turn left into Loretto Park and follow it around to the right
Come back out the same way, keeping right turn left onto Nun's Walk
At the end of the road turn right onto Pearse Road
Turn left onto Pouladuff Road Lower and continue toward the roundabout
At the roundabout take the exit onto Pouladuff Road Lower, then at the next roundabout take the slight left onto West Link
Follow the on ramp straight ahead and merge onto the South Ring Road
Stay on the dual carriageway for around 1 km take the off ramp on the left
At the rotary take the exit onto Sarsfield Road heading back toward Wilton
Turn right into Doughcloyne Industrial Estate, work your way through with a right, another right, and a left within the estate
Turn right back onto Sarsfield Road right onto Eagle Valley, and finally left onto Garrane Dara to finish the route close to the test centre
